 Air India to offer upgraded cabins on all Heathrow flights
 By Keith Mwanalushi October 21, 2026 Aircraft , Airlines , Featured , IFE , Interiors , Routes No Comments Air India has announced that all flights to and from London Heathrow will operate with new or upgraded cabin interiors from January 2027.
 The milestone will be achieved when the airline’s daily service between London Heathrow and Bengaluru transitions from a legacy Boeing 787-8 to a retrofitted Boeing 787-8 aircraft.
 The upgraded aircraft features redesigned cabin interiors, new seats and a new inflight entertainment system. The cabin configuration has also been changed from two classes to three classes with the introduction of premium economy.
 Over the past two years, Air India has progressively introduced aircraft with new or upgraded cabins on its Heathrow services.
 Flights between London Heathrow and Delhi are currently operated by a mix of Airbus A350-900 and Boeing 787-9 aircraft, while services between London Heathrow and Mumbai are operated by a mix of new Boeing 787-9 and retrofitted Boeing 787-8 aircraft.
 The Bengaluru upgrade means all Air India services at Heathrow will operate using aircraft equipped with the airline’s latest cabin products from January 2027.
